# discord_server_preview (Data Source)

Reads the public preview of a server. The bot does not need to be a member of discoverable servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Works for discoverable servers the bot is not a member of.
data "discord_server_preview" "partner" {
  id = var.partner_server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server ID.

### Read-Only

- `approximate_member_count` (Number) Approximate number of members.
- `approximate_presence_count` (Number) Approximate number of online members.
- `description` (String) Server description.
- `discovery_splash_hash` (String) Hash of the discovery splash image.
- `emojis` (Attributes List) Custom emojis. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emojis))
- `features` (Set of String) Enabled server features.
- `icon_hash` (String) Hash of the server icon.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `splash_hash` (String) Hash of the invite splash image.
- `stickers` (Attributes List) Custom stickers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stickers))

<a id="nestedatt--emojis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `emojis`

Read-Only:

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is animated.
- `id` (String) Emoji ID.
- `name` (String) Emoji name.


<a id="nestedatt--stickers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stickers`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Sticker description.
- `id` (String) Sticker ID.
- `name` (String) Sticker name.
